title: Repository evidence and change triage
description: Separate observed GitHub metadata changes from verified build, release, and security outcomes.
knowledge: Treat a pushed_at change as activity, never as proof of tests, functionality, or release readiness.
Pin inspections to an exact commit SHA and record the repository ID, source URL, observation time, and limits of evidence.
Distinguish a repository that is no longer visible from a repository confirmed deleted.
Collect CI, license, build, dependencies, and release proof separately; mark uninspected aspects unknown.
Keep private-repository paths and derived inventory on a local authorized service, never on public Pages.
provenance: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (project policy; validate against exact code revision)
